messages:
Sophie: Heads up — noticed ~30m gap in audit logs for DSAR deletion events around 2026-03-18 03:12 UTC. This affects evidence packet for legal. :eyes:
James: Do you mean audit_logs shard-3 or the central aggregator?
Sophie: Aggregator. shard metrics look ok but aggregator shows repeated 'sync_timeout' errors. Posting query I ran:
```sql
-- query run on analytics
SELECT * FROM audit_logs
WHERE event_type IN ('DSAR_ERASE','EMBED_DELETE')
AND ts BETWEEN '2026-03-18T03:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-18T04:00:00Z';
```
Sophie: Result: missing events for customer_id=acct_93bd... there are tombstone writes in blobstore but no corresponding audit record.
Dan: @Sophie can you share logs from audit-collector? cc @dsar-bot
Sophie: Pasting tail from collector (trimmed):
[collector] 2026-03-18T02:57:58Z INFO batch=41 accepted
[collector] 2026-03-18T02:58:02Z ERROR sync_timeout shard=3 ctx=keystore-rotate job=replicate
[collector] 2026-03-18T02:58:15Z WARN retrying batch=42
[blobstore] 2026-03-18T02:59:05Z INFO tombstone write blob=b-1a2b3c customer=acct_93bd
Sophie: So we have tombstone in storage but no audit entry.
Ellen: Legal needs verifiable chain for that DSAR — can we supply backup audit export or attest to mitigation?
James: Possible root causes: 1) RBAC change revoked collector SA read on keystore, 2) KMS rekey caused collector backpressure, 3) aggregator had GC bug. I'll check RBAC logs and collector metrics.
Dan: I'll own collector logs. Spinning a runbook:
1) snapshot blobstore tombstones -> s3://redwood-temp/dsar-evidence/3789012345
2) dump collector metrics + exporter logs -> /tmp/collector-dump-3789.tar.gz
3) generate temporary attest using sigstore key -> attach to legal
Sophie: If RBAC change is suspect: who changed service-account? Audit shows iam-change by 'infra-deploy-bot' at 02:58 UTC. @James can you confirm?
James: Confirmed — infra-deploy-bot performed an automated patch at 2026-03-18T02:58:00Z. Patch removed 'storage.objects.list' for collector-sa by accident. Rolling back now, PR: https://git.redwood/infrastructure/pulls/4128 (rollback id: rback-2026-4128).
Sophie: :thumbsup: After rollback, can we re-run sync and rehydrate missing audit records? What's our fallback if rehydrate fails?
Dan: Fallback: create 'evidence-manual' manifest with tombstone blobs + collector tails + signer attestation. Legal indicated that's acceptable temporarily but needs timeline and RCA.
Ellen: Legal: OK to accept manual manifest for now. Need timeline, RCA, and confirmation that no other DSARs are impacted within 72 hours.
Sophie: Opening an incident ticket and tagging severity P2. Ticket: INC-2026-3342. Assigning @James and @Dan. Will update once re-sync completes.
dsar-bot: Automated note: DSAR case acct_93bd update queued. Evidence attached: none. Waiting for manual manifest.
Sophie: Thanks — I'll follow up with re-sync logs and the rollback confirmation here.
